title: Output_Display - a display-only graph output shown on a Flow final stage instead of the saved result
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-748 - Head Swap on Klein follow-ups (created 2026-09-13; itself a member of MPI-560). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-748/plan.md.

DECIDED by Fabio 2026-09-13. A Flow graph may carry ONE extra image or video node titled Output_Display: a view assembled INSIDE the graph, shown on the Flow's final stage once the run finishes. Absent -> the stage shows Output_Image / Output_Video exactly as today. It is never saved: not a gallery card, not a project file. Why a graph node and not per-flow UI: the layout lives in the workflow, so no Flow ever needs its own interface to show it. First consumer: the Klein Head Swap graph (MPI-744) - both inputs stacked beside the result (ImageConcatenate x2), resized to 2 MP.

NAME: Output_Preview was the first pick and is TAKEN - it is the stage-1 preview capture of multi-stage video ops (LTX, Wan, H3), read ONLY on previewOnly runs (commandExecutor.js, _captureTitle), so a normal run ignores it silently. Output_Image_2 is wrong too: every Output_Image* becomes its own gallery card, and a run with several outputs drops the compare slider.

APP WORK (code read 2026-09-13):
- Capture: commandExecutor.js builds its title sets beside output_prompt / output_splat. Add an EXACT output_display set, collected with collectComfyOutputUrls (js/utils/comfyOutputUrls.js has no type filter, so a PreviewImage writing to ComfyUI temp works), kept OUT of outputNodeIds so it never becomes a card, and handed to onComplete as its own field next to promptText / splatUrl.
- Surface: MpiBaseFlow.js _defaultResultMode picks compare / player / plain; add 'display'. PROPOSED default, Fabio to confirm: display wins the first paint, and the existing surface toggle still reaches compare (Head Swap declares result.compare) and the video player. The display must not count toward the several-outputs check.
- Reopen (MPI-587): state.s_flowResults {items, mode, status, pending} gains the display URL. A temp /view URL dies when ComfyUI restarts, so the existing HEAD probe must fall back to the saved result, never to an empty pane. Reuse across an app restart (openFlowFromReuse, from the sidecar) shows the saved result with no display - by design.
- Video: same title on a video node. Core SaveVideo writes to ComfyUI output/, not temp - pick the node at the bench.

SYNC: Flow raw graphs (bare name) convert through scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs, which drops only muted and bypassed nodes, so Output_Display survives. The MODEL generators (generate_*.py, CAPTURE_TITLES) prune every node not upstream of a listed title: a model op adopting Output_Display must add the title there or lose it silently.

DOCS: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/result-pane.md gains an Output_Display section; the capture-title comment in commandExecutor.js lists it.

VERIFY: a Flow WITH Output_Display shows it on the final stage and still lands exactly ONE gallery card; a Flow WITHOUT it is unchanged (tests/flow-result-compare.test.cjs stays green); close->reopen shows the display, and after an engine restart falls back to the result; on Head Swap the toggle still reaches compare.
